text:
maria: proposal — add a 'cost lineage' control to the cost dashboard. toggled on it overlays per-route cache-savings attribution, per-model cost splits, and a brief confidence ribbon. default off.

sam: I like it. two asks: show both absolute token savings and percent of route cost saved, and expose sampling rate somewhere obvious. also we should be clear whether prefetch vs hotpath credits are shown separately.

jordan: telemetry status: we emit cache_hit events and prefetch_start/complete, and we stamp requests with route_id when available. the hard part is linking a prefetch hit back to the origin route across async chains and when tokens are proxied by internal agents.

lee: heuristic idea: when origin_route_id missing, look back in the request path for the last authenticated route within 30s and attribute tentatively; otherwise we fall back to proportional split by token-length and model cost. annotate those rows with low confidence.

sam: backend checklist: 1) add optional origin_route_id to cache_hit events (nullable) 2) nightly dedupe/reconcile worker to collapse duplicate credits from chain forks 3) internal API /internal/v1/cost_lineage?start=&end=&route= that returns line items with confidence.

maria: UX: toggle sits on the top-right of the cost card with tooltip: 'Infer cache savings and per-model breakdown. Confidence shown when attribution relies on heuristics or sampling.' clicking any attributed row opens an 'explain' flyout showing the give-away evidence.

jordan: reconcile prototype SQL to find ambiguous prefetches:

````
select p.prefetch_id, count(distinct ch.origin_route_id) as route_count, array_agg(distinct ch.origin_route_id) as origin_routes, sum(ch.savings_tokens) as total_savings_tokens
from cache_hits ch
join prefetches p on ch.prefetch_id = p.id
where ch.ts > now() - interval '7 days'
group by p.prefetch_id;
````

then apply apportionment rules: full credit if single origin route, otherwise weight by candidate route token share.

lee: implementation nuance: sampling. some internal proxies sample cache hits at 1/10. we need to surface sampling_factor and inflate counts accordingly, and show an uncertainty interval. recommend a conservative CI where low-sample or heuristic attribution gets a wider interval.

sam: API shape suggestion (internal only):

````
GET /internal/v1/cost_lineage?start=2026-01-01T00:00Z&end=2026-01-08T00:00Z
returns: [{ route_id: "r_123", model: "redwood-4x", savings_tokens: 12345, savings_cost_usd: 12.34, confidence: 0.87, sampling_factor: 10 }, ...]
````

maria: rollout: feature-flag + tenant opt-in beta. start with 10 high-usage tenants and a Redwood-internal beta org. collect feedback on explain panel clarity and confidence interpretation.

jordan: ops alert: if reconcile worker's attributed_savings deviates >12% from raw cache_hits_savings across any weekly window, fire a pager or create an investigation ticket. also emit a reconciliation metric for each run.

lee: gating: prefactor reconcile should be idempotent and run with a dry-run mode before flipping. add a small 'reconcile run details' modal in console showing sample queries and top ambiguous prefetch_ids.

ops-bot: reconcile-worker/weekly-run completed (5732468301) :white_check_mark: records_processed=23456 reconciled_prefetches=1987 deviation_pct=3.1

sam: i'll prototype the cost card mock (mock toggled on) and a compact explain flyout tomorrow. will include sample confidence badges (high/medium/low). tagging @maria for acceptance criteria.

maria: acceptance criteria: (1) console toggle present and off by default, (2) internal API returns per-route savings with numeric confidence and sampling_factor, (3) explain flyout with evidence for any attributed credit, (4) reconcile worker implemented with dry-run and production modes, (5) beta opt-in gating + telemetry for feedback. i'll draft docs and a small FAQ for customers. thanks all.
